# The Wringer

> Turn vague AI agent ideas into checkable work orders, then audit or execute them.

The Wringer is an agent-native web application at https://www.thewringer.ai. Humans and browser
agents use the same visible work order state through native WebMCP. It turns plain English into a
structured work order (goal, checkable acceptance criteria, boundaries), then offers two paid
actions:

- **$1 Audit**: stress-tests the contract with a hostile reviewer, returns a graded dry run
  plus a repaired work order you can apply in one click.
- **$10+ MECHA Run**: real multi-agent execution in an isolated Daytona sandbox, with an
  evidence chain and an independent reviewer verdict.

## WebMCP tools

- `create_case_file`: update and save the visible work order
- `review_case_file`: validate and compile the current work order
- `run_quick_attack`: stage the $1 audit for human confirmation
- `apply_audit_repairs`: apply the latest audit repairs to the visible form
- `start_full_case`: stage a MECHA run for human confirmation
- `get_full_case_status`: read progress and the final result already visible on the page

Paid actions never create checkout or spend until the human confirms with the visible control.

## Pricing

- Grok coach and work order form: free
- Audit: $1 per run
- MECHA run: starts at $10, scales with agent count (capped)

## Notes for AI crawlers

- Endpoints under /api/ are internal. Browser agents should use the registered WebMCP tools.
- Tool schemas and live page state are authoritative for agent interaction.
- The canonical host is https://www.thewringer.ai (the apex domain redirects).
